description: Estimate a transaction’s base and priority fee from its signer count and Compute Budget instructions, then simulate it to report consumed compute units and execution errors. It never broadcasts or signs. Priority cost is only calculable when both a compute-unit limit and price are present. Example: {"transaction":"<base64 serialized VersionedTransaction>","network":"devnet"} Cost: 3 free calls, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402. Calls that return an error are not charged.

network.description: Solana cluster to query. Use mainnet-beta for real assets or devnet for test data; defaults to mainnet-beta.

transaction.description: Base64-encoded serialized VersionedTransaction. Legacy transaction serialization is not accepted.

name: estimate_transaction_cost
